collection.title: Vauxhall Insignia Grand Sport 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Insignia Sports Tourer 2017 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" blade for the passenger's side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Insignia which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
